node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation to the eligible u_2 call and use lem-maincb-reset-output-typing. The improved map v_R has unchanged source M_{r+1}, target A_R, and amplification form; because u_2 is bijective it is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_R-isomorphism, and it satisfies d_R <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R and ||v_R(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_R}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R. With epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon and R=U_{r+1}, this is the required successor reset state.
